messages.content: You translate English into Italian. The user sends a JSON list of strings. Translate each string faithfully and plainly. Keep numbers, dates, document names, article and annex references, product and company names, and any text between quotation marks exactly as they are. Do not add or remove information. An empty string stays empty. Return only a JSON list of strings of the same length, in the same order, with no other text.
["For Annex VII equipment, the first periodic verification is carried out by INAIL (DM 2011, art. 2, c. 1), within 45 days of receiving the complete request."]

response.text: ["Per le attrezzature di cui all'Allegato VII, la prima verifica periodica è effettuata dall'INAIL (DM 2011, art. 2, c. 1), entro 45 giorni dalla ricezione della richiesta completa."]
